steps.en: Deploy the CODE server on your cluster with the Helm chart
steps.zh: 用 Helm chart 把 CODE 服务器部署上集群

steps.en: Tell it which WOPI host may call: your file platform's URL
steps.zh: 告诉它哪个 WOPI host 可以调用：你的文件平台 URL

steps.en: coolwsd brokers editor sessions for your documents
steps.zh: coolwsd 为你的文档调度编辑器会话

steps.en: Users click a file in your drive — the editor opens in the browser
steps.zh: 用户在网盘里点文件——浏览器里编辑器直接打开

steps.en: The LibreOffice engine renders and merges edits live for everyone
steps.zh: LibreOffice 引擎为所有人实时渲染并合并编辑

steps.en: Saved versions go back to your WOPI host's storage
steps.zh: 保存的新版本落回你的 WOPI host 存储

value.en: A desktop-grade office editor inside your self-hosted drive, colleagues already in the file — storage, accounts, and sharing stay yours
value.zh: 自托管网盘里多了一个桌面级办公编辑器，同事已经在文件里——存储、账号、分享仍然归你
